run.decision: FAIL / MATCHED TOTAL-RETURN AUDIT DOES NOT CONFIRM ROBUST IWD VALUE ALPHA. IWD remained directionally better than matched SPY: evaluation CAGR 14.509755% vs SPY 14.465392% and Sharpe 1.547475 vs 1.535352, with 5/7 fold Sharpe wins, equal full MDD 7.689054%, and cumulative 41-candidate DSR 97.577%. However paired 20000-replicate bootstrap gave P(CAGR IWD>SPY)=67.210% and P(Sharpe IWD>SPY)=88.065%, both below the frozen 90% gates. Therefore robust_strategy_pass=false. ATM-SVP2-US-VALUE-PROD-001 remains a truthful PASS under its original price-index comparator, but it cannot support a value-premium/product V12 promotion after this stricter matched-total-return audit. The already frozen IWD prospective trial is suspended; no SPY/IWD blend, timing, alternate start, ETF replacement, or threshold rescue is permitted.

methodology.follow_up_policy: This is a methodology-correction audit, not a rescue search. After formal performance is opened, do not change SPY, IWD, adjusted-close price field, 2000-05-30 start, substitution fraction, calendar alignment, folds, thresholds, fees, target path, or add any third comparator. If the audit fails, ATM-SVP2-US-VALUE-PROD-001 remains a truthful historical PASS under its original preregistration but its value-premium/product-upgrade interpretation is downgraded; the IWD V12 prospective/product promotion must be suspended rather than rescued. If the audit passes, the exact IWD rule remains frozen and its existing prospective clock may continue without historical retuning.
